I see you're using `vite-plugin-svgr` to handle SVGs. The current configuration, with `exportType: "named"` and `namedExport: "ReactComponent"`, means you should be importing SVGs as React components.

Now, let's see how an SVG is actually being used in one of your components. I'll check `src/components/header/Header.tsx` as headers are a common place for logos. I will examine how the logo SVG is imported and rendered.

---

Read file: src/components/header/Header.tsx

---

The problem is clear.

In `vite.config.ts`, you have configured `vite-plugin-svgr` to create named exports called `ReactComponent` for your SVGs. However, in `Header.tsx`, you are trying to use the SVG as a standard image file with an `<img>` tag:

```tsx
<img
  className="dark:hidden"
  src="./images/logo/polly_logo.svg"
  alt="Logo"
/>
```

This will not work with your current Vite setup. The `svgr` plugin intercepts the SVG import and turns it into a React component, so it can no longer be used as the `src` for an image tag. In addition, the hamburger icons in this file are not imported at all, but instead the raw SVG code is used. I will change all of these to be imported as React Components.

To fix this, I will modify `src/components/header/Header.tsx` to correctly import and use the SVGs as React components. I will also change the Vite config file to simplify the import statement.It appears the issue is a mismatch between your Vite configuration and how you're using SVGs. Your `vite-plugin-svgr` is set up to convert SVGs into React components, but you're attempting to use them as image sources.

I'll correct this by updating `vite.config.ts` and `src/components/header/Header.tsx` to properly import and render the SVGs as React components. This will include replacing the inline SVG code for the hamburger icons with imported components for better consistency.

You've hit on a subtle but important aspect of how Vite handles assets. When you import an SVG as a React component and its file size is small (typically under 4KB), Vite inlines it as a base64 data URI for performance. This is why it appears to be hardcoded.

The problem of it being too small on the sign-in page, despite the `width` and `height` props, suggests those props aren't being correctly applied to the SVG element. The issue of it not showing up in other places is likely a similar props-related problem or an incorrect import.

To solve this once and for all and ensure consistency, I will create a dedicated, reusable `Logo` component. This component will wrap the SVG, apply default sizing, and allow for overrides via props. This will ensure the logo looks correct wherever it's used.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useSidebar } from "../context/SidebarContext";
import { Logo } from "../components/common/Logo";
import {
  HomeIcon,
  BoxIcon,
  BoltIcon,
  User2Icon,
  PlugInIcon,
  FormInputIcon,
} from "../icons";

const AppSidebar = () => {
  const location = useLocation();
  const { pathname } = location;

  const { isExpanded, isHovered, toggleSidebar, isMobileOpen } = useSidebar();
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const sidebar = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const [isHovering, setIsHovering] = useState(false);

  const handleMouseEnter = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isExpanded) {
      setIsHovering(true);
    }
  }, [isExpanded]);

  const handleMouseLeave = useCallback(() => {
    setIsHovering(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const clickHandler = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!sidebar.current || !trigger.current) return;
      if (
        !isMobileOpen ||
        sidebar.current.contains(event.target as Node) ||
        trigger.current.contains(event.target as Node)
      )
        return;
    };
    document.addEventListener("click", clickHandler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("click", clickHandler);
  }, [isMobileOpen]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={sidebar}
      onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
      onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
      className={`absolute left-0 top-0 z-[9999] flex h-screen w-[290px] flex-col overflow-y-hidden bg-white duration-300 ease-linear dark:bg-gray-900 lg:static lg:translate-x-0 ${
        isMobileOpen ? "translate-x-0" : "-translate-x-full"

          <Link to="/">
            <Logo />
          </Link>

                fill=""
              />
            </svg>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col overflow-y-auto duration-300 ease-linear">
        <div

        >
          <Link

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

import {
  HomeIcon,

  User2Icon,
} from "../icons";

const AppSidebar = () => {
  const location = useLocation();
  const { pathname } = location;

  const { isExpanded, toggleSidebar, isMobileOpen } = useSidebar();
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const sidebar = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const [isHovering, setIsHovering] = useState(false);

  const handleMouseEnter = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isExpanded) setIsHovering(true);
  }, [isExpanded]);

  const handleMouseLeave = useCallback(() => setIsHovering(false), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const clickHandler = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!sidebar.current || !trigger.current) return;
      if (
        !isMobileOpen ||
        sidebar.current.contains(event.target as Node) ||
        trigger.current.contains(event.target as Node)
      )
        return;
    };
    document.addEventListener("click", clickHandler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("click", clickHandler);
  }, [isMobileOpen]);

  return (

      onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
      onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}

+ import React, { useState } from 'react'
+ import { Link, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'
+ import { useSidebar } from '../context/SidebarContext'
+ import { ChevronDownIcon } from '../icons'
+ 
+ interface NavItem {
+   name: string
+   icon: React.ReactNode
+   path?: string
+   subItems?: { name: string; path: string; pro?: boolean; new?: boolean }[]
+ }
+ 
+ interface SidebarLinkProps {
+   item: NavItem
+ }
+ 
+ function SidebarLink({ item }: SidebarLinkProps) {
+   const { pathname } = useLocation()
+   const { isExpanded, isHovering } = useSidebar()
+   const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)
+ 
+   const hasSubItems = item.subItems && item.subItems.length > 0
+   const isLinkActive = (path?: string) => path && pathname === path
+   const isGroupActive = (subItems?: any[]) =>
+     subItems && subItems.some(sub => pathname.includes(sub.path))
+ 
+   const handleToggle = () => {
+     if (hasSubItems) {
+       setIsOpen(!isOpen)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const showText = isExpanded || isHovering
+ 
+   if (hasSubItems) {
+     return (
+       <li
+         className={`mb-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1.5 ${
+           isGroupActive(item.subItems) ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-500'
+         }`}
+       >
+         <button
+           onClick={handleToggle}
+           className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-left font-medium duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 ${
+             isGroupActive(item.subItems)
+               ? 'bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700'
+               : ''
+           }`}
+         >
+           <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
+             {item.icon}
+             {showText && <span>{item.name}</span>}
+           </div>
+           {showText && (
+             <ChevronDownIcon
+               className={`transform transition-transform duration-200 ${
+                 isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''
+               }`}
+             />
+           )}
+         </button>
+         {isOpen && (
+           <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 pl-8 pt-1.5">
+             {item.subItems?.map(subItem => (
+               <li key={subItem.name}>
+                 <Link
+                   to={subItem.path}
+                   className={`block rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm duration-300 ease-in-out hover:text-white ${
+                     isLinkActive(subItem.path) ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-400'
+                   }`}
+                 >
+                   {subItem.name}
+                 </Link>
+               </li>
+             ))}
+           </ul>
+         )}
+       </li>
+     )
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     <li>
+       <Link
+         to={item.path || '#'}
+         className={`flex items-center gap-3.5 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 ${
+           isLinkActive(item.path)
+             ? 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-900 dark:bg-gray-700 dark:text-white'
+             : 'text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400'
+         }`}
+       >
+         {item.icon}
+         {showText && <span>{item.name}</span>}
+       </Link>
+     </li>
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ export default SidebarLink

```javascript
function groupBy(array: any[], key: string,  nestedKey?: string) {
  return array.reduce((result, item) => {
    let groupKey : string
    if (nestedKey && item[key] && typeof item[key] === "object") { 
      groupKey = item[key][nestedKey] || "Unassigned"
    } else {
       // Fallback for non-nested or simple properties
      groupKey = item[key] || "Unassigned" 
    }

    // Ensure the key exists in the result object
    if (!result[groupKey]) { 
      result[groupKey] = []
    }
    result[groupKey].push(item)
     return result
  }, {})
}
```

+ export function Analytics({ jobs }: AnalyticsProps) {
+   // Get current date and calculate date ranges
+   const now = new Date()
+   const oneMonthAgo = subMonths(now, 1)
+   const currentYearStart = startOfYear(now)
+   const lastYearStart = startOfYear(subYears(now, 1))
+   const lastYearEnd = endOfYear(subYears(now, 1))
+ 
+   // Filter tasks created this year to date
+   const tasksThisYear = jobs.filter(job => {
+     if (!job.created_at) return false
+     const createdDate = parseISO(job.created_at)
+     return isWithinInterval(createdDate, { start: currentYearStart, end: now })
+   })
+ 
+   // Filter tasks created last year
+   const tasksLastYear = jobs.filter(job => {
+     if (!job.created_at) return false
+     const createdDate = parseISO(job.created_at)
+     return isWithinInterval(createdDate, { start: lastYearStart, end: lastYearEnd })
+   })
+ 
+   // Filter completed tasks
+   const completedTasks = jobs.filter(job => job.job_status?.description === "Completed")
+ 
+   // Filter completed tasks in the last month
+   const completedLastMonth = jobs.filter(job => {
+     if (job.job_status?.description !== "Completed" || !job.completion_date) return false
+     return isAfter(job.completion_date, oneMonthAgo)
+   })
+ 
+   // Filter completed tasks in the year to date
+   const completedYearToDate = jobs.filter(job => {
+     if (job.job_status?.description !== "Completed" || !job.completion_date) return false
+     return isWithinInterval(job.completion_date, { start: currentYearStart, end: now })
+   })
+ 
+   // Filter outstanding tasks (not completed)
+   const outstandingTasks = jobs.filter(job => job.job_status?.description !== "Completed")
+ 
+   // Calculate percentages
+   const totalJobs = jobs.length
+   const completedPercentage =
+     totalJobs > 0 ? Math.round((completedTasks.length / totalJobs) * 100) : 0
+   const outstandingPercentage =
+     totalJobs > 0 ? Math.round((outstandingTasks.length / totalJobs) * 100) : 0
+ 
+   const totalOutstanding = outstandingTasks.length
+ 
+   const outstandingByDivision = outstandingTasks.reduce(
+     (acc, job) => {
+       const divisionName = job.production_plant?.name || "Unassigned"
+       acc[divisionName] = (acc[divisionName] || 0) + 1
+       return acc
+     },
+     {} as Record<string, number>,
+   )
+ 
+   const divisionsPieData = Object.entries(outstandingByDivision).map(([name, count]) => ({

+     y: count,
+     z: totalOutstanding > 0 ? (count / totalOutstanding) * 100 : 0,

+ 
+   // Group tasks by assignee

+       ).length,
+       outstanding: (tasks as Job[]).filter(
+         j => j.job_status?.description !== "Completed",
+       ).length,
+     }),
+   )
+ 
+   const assigneeCategories = assigneeData.map(d => d.name)
+   const assigneeCompletedCounts = assigneeData.map(d => d.completed)
+   const assigneeOutstandingCounts = assigneeData.map(d => d.outstanding)
+ 
+   // Group tasks by requestor
+   const tasksByRequestor = groupBy(jobs, "requestor", "name")
+   const requestorData = Object.entries(tasksByRequestor).map(

+       // The name of the requestor, or "Unassigned" if it's not available
+       const name =
+         requestor && requestor !== "null" ? requestor : "Unassigned"
+       const totalTasks = (tasks as Job[]).length
+ 
+       return {
+         name,
+         total: totalTasks,
+       }
+     },
+   )
+ 
+   const requestorCategories = requestorData.map(d => d.name)
+   const requestorCounts = requestorData.map(d => d.total)
+   const averageTasksPerRequestor =
+     requestorCounts.reduce((acc, count) => acc + count, 0) /
+     (requestorCategories.length || 1)
+ 
+   // Monthly counts for current and last year
+   const getMonthlyCounts = (tasks: Job[]): number[] => {

+   const currentYearMonthlyCounts = getMonthlyCounts(tasksThisYear)
